sections.label: CPE enforcement outcomes
sections.summary: Since CPE's 2009 inception, eight renewal applications were rejected, six PEIs ordered to close, and four cases taken to Court.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Since CPE's inception in 2009, eight applications for renewal of registration were rejected.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Six PEIs have been ordered to close, due to regulatory contraventions.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: Thus far, four cases have been taken to Court.

sections.label: Monitoring and Investigation Department
sections.summary: In 2014 CPE established a Monitoring and Investigation Department for early detection and identification of enforcement issues.

sentences.speaker: The Acting Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills) (Mr Ong Ye Kung)
sentences.text: To improve its responsiveness, in 2014, it established a Monitoring and Investigation Department, dedicated to early detection and identification of enforcement issues.

sections.label: Singaporean student intake numbers
sections.summary: Annual intake of Singaporean students is about 14,000, compared with about 7,000 for NUS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Every year, the intake of Singaporean students alone is about 14,000.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: In comparison, for NUS, it is about 7,000.

sections.label: Raising university cohort participation
sections.summary: Along with SkillsFuture, an initiative aims to raise the University cohort participation rate from 32% to 40% by 2020.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: It may not be a degree now, it may be a degree later and all kinds of paths start to open up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: This is why, along with SkillsFuture, it is an important initiative to raise our University cohort participation rate from the current 32% to 40% by 2020.

sections.label: MOE tender for PEI survey
sections.summary: The Straits Times reported MOE calling a tender to survey eight or nine top PEIs on employment outcomes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As the Member may notice, The Straits Times picked up news on MOE calling for a tender, picking out eight or nine of the top PEIs with the largest intake, to conduct a survey in order to establish what are the employment outcomes.
